attributes.board_name: Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation (IDFPR) - Board of Nursing

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses offered or sponsored by an approved Illinois CE sponsor; CE used for another state's license also counts
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE required for the first renewal of an Illinois license (Rules Section 1300.130(a)(4)).
rules.audit_note: Certificates are not sent with an on-time renewal; they may be requested in a CE audit.

topics.who: nurses with direct care of adults 26+
nurses who work with children (DCFS training); others attest at each renewal

rules.notes: Mandatory topics count toward the 20 hours. RN renewal falls in even years (last cycle completed in 2024 per IDFPR FAQ); exact expiry date not confirmed from a current official page.
rules.legal_basis: Rules for the Administration of the Nurse Practice Act, Section 1300.130 Continuing Education
